(tsa)༄༅/ /glo bo sde pa bkra shis mgon gyis bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i dkar chag tu gnang ba bzhugs so/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/lhun grub rgyun

tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// glo bo sde pa bkra shis mgon gyis bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i dkar chag tu gnang ba bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las kyi// gos dmar gyis klubs ye shes nyi ma ni// thugs rje'i shing rta la zhon 'gro don gyi// lam du bde bar rgyu la phyag bgyi'o// mi 'gyur bde chen shin tu zab pa'i thugs// stong nyid tshon brgyas rnam par gsal ba'i sku// zung 'jug 'khor los sgyur ba'i gsung dbyangs kyis// tshul chen gsung ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mā la ya rlung bsil ba'i lang tsho las// dal bur drangs pa'i ha ri tsan+dan gyi// ngad 'jam ji bzhin snying gi gdung ba ni// 'phrog byed dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs 'char ka'i mdangs gsal gzhon nu yis// rnam par 'khyud pa'i zhal gyi mdangs dkar ba// 'gro blo'i 'thibs po sel la dus rtag tu// brtson mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag bgyi'o// de las byung ba'i chos kyi char chen pos// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par gnas bcas nas// phrin las chu chen 'bebs la rtag gzhol ba// 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho che khyod bsngags par 'os// dkon mchog gsum dngos rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// yan lag bdun ldan sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs nas// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbus su rtag rol ba// dngos grub kun gyi gter la phyag bgyi'o// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i mgon du thugs bskyed nas// bskal chen gsum du rlabs chen tshogs mang po// nges bskrun mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sku// 'char nub rol rtsed du ma'i mdzad pa yis// rnam shes me long rnyed pa'i gdul bya la// khams dang dbang po'i go rim ji lta bar// theg gsum chos kyi gdangs dbyangs rgya mtsho yis// pha rol phyin pa'i sgo brgya tha mar phye// sku gsung 'gag med bde chen gar stabs can// zag med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam rol gyis// ye shes me long rnyed pa'i blo chen la// theg mchog gsung la rgyun chad mi mnga' yang*// yul dus nges med gang du gang 'tsham der// chags can 'gro ba khrid mdzad sprul pa'i sku// rang rang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skur bzhengs nas// sna tshogs rgyud sde'i ring pa bgrang yas gsungs// yul dus la lar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku// chags bral tshangs pa spyod pa'i cha lugs kyis// rig 'dzin chos kyi rnam grangs mang gsungs pa// grub chen mang pos tshul chen lam du bkral// gang 'dir rig 'dzin gnas dang mkha' la spyod// 'og min la sogs dag pa'i zhing dag na// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i blo la rtag bzhugs nas// nam yang 'gro don mdzad la rgyun chad med// 'on kyang ma dag zhing du sngags kyi tshul// mchog gi sprul pas gsungs pa brgya lam tsam// de phyir rgyal ba 'jig rten byon pa dang*// de yis dam pa'i chos tshul gsungs pa dang*// khyad par zab mo sngags kyi tshul gsungs pa// rnyed par dka' zhing ches cher dkon par grags// gang 'dir tshul chen bstan pa rnyed pa dang*// de don tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dge legs ni// rtsod bral rgyud sde'i glegs bam tshogs rnams dang*// gong ma'i srol bzhin 'chad pa'i smra mkhas dang*// de sgrub byed pa'i rnal 'byor can dag la// rag las de phyir de dang de dag kyang*// zung 'jug rgyal ba nyid bzhin bkur bar 'os// thub chen ston pas tshul chen gang gsungs pa// 'phags yul nyid du rim par bzhugs pa dang*// phyi ma'i dus su rig 'dzin la la yis// sham bha la dang au ḍiṇ+ḍ+ya sogs nas// rgyud chen rgyas pa'i bsdus pa'i rgyud 'ga' dang*// khol bur phyung pa'i gzhung 'ga' spyan drangs nas// sngags gzhung zab mo'i nyi ma cher 'bar bas// 'phags pa'i yul gyi sa chen gsal bar byas// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa nyid la yang*// rtsod pa byung na tshul 'dir smos ci dgos// de phyir 'phags pa'i yul du rig 'dzin rgyud// gsang bar gdams nas zab mor sbas pa yin// rgyal ba 'da' tshul bstan nas ring zhig na// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sprul pa yis// gangs can yul ljongs gshin por byas pa las// 'gro mang bdud rtsi'i snod du gyur pa'i tshe// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul khri srong bka' stsal gyis// ka co gzhang gsum sprul pa'i lo tsā bas// 'khrul med theg gsum dam chos nges bsgyur nas// phyag rgyas btab pa kun gyi spyi bor blangs// dus der mtsho skyes la sogs grub chen gyi// thugs la bzhugs pa'i bla med sngags kyi lam// glegs bam ngos su gsal bar bkod pa na// gsang sngags snga 'gyur zhes bya'i lam srol dod// sangs rgyas gsang ba las 'ongs rnal 'byor rgyud// rtsod bral rgya dpe'i ngos las legs bsgyur ba// dus der byon nas deng sang bar du yang*// ma nyams dri ma med pa de bzhugs so// de don nyams su len pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// zab mo'i lam la tshul bzhin gzhol ba na// dngos grub rnam gnyis len la dbang thob pa'i// rig 'dzin sa la bzhugs pa mang zhig byon// sngon tshe gangs can ljongs 'dir rig pa 'dzin// phal cher 'dod lha'i zhags pas bzung ba na// sngags gzhung dam tshig khyab 'jug gzhung lugs dang*// drag po'i gzhung bzhin bsgrub pa mang zhig byung*// dus der rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul lo tsā ba// rig 'dzin sar bzhugs rin chen bzang po yis// rgyud sde bzhi yi glegs bam ma nyams pa// tshig don ma 'khrul ji bzhin bod du bsgyur// gsang sngags log par spyod pa sun 'byin pa'i// bstan bcos mdzad nas bshad pa'i srol chen gyis// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po dang*// sgrub pa'i gdugs dkar dri ma med de bzung*// de nas 'jigs med dpal ldan sa skya pa// 'jam dpal rnon po'i rnam 'phrul lo tsā bas// mdo sngags chos kyi gru chen der zhugs nas// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi// lung dang rigs pa'i sbyong tshul rim gsum pos// thub bstan nor bu'i dri ma mtha' dag dang*// sngags gzhung log par bsgrub pa kun sbyangs nas// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse la gsal bar bkod// de nas de yi chos tshul kun mkhyen zhing*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang bsgyur kun dga'i mtshan bzang 'dzin po yis// mdo sngags chos kyi rnam rol ci yang byas// de yi phrin las yid la nyer sim pas// sa chen skyong mdzad bstan pa'i rim gro pa// rnam dpyod bkra shis nyin por byed pa'i mgon// mthon po'i rigs kyi dgung la nges shar ba// pha rol phrag dog lag pas ma mnan zhing*// tshu rol mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba dang*// chos dang srid kyi dbu rmog gong nas gong*// rnam par btsan zhing mtho ba'i dus gang 'dir// bai ḍūr+ya sngon zhu ba 'khyil 'dra ba'i// mthing shog glegs bur bgyis pa'i ngos 'jam la// btso ma'i gser 'od 'bur du dod pa yi// bka' lung 'gyur ro 'tshal ba 'di 'khrungs so// gang 'di gsung gi dbang phyug 'od dpag med// dam chos yongs kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnams thams cad pa'i// bkra shis bde legs gang yod deng 'dir spyon// rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus// pha rol bdud dpung 'joms mdzad gshin rje'i gshed// phrin las mdzod gyur rnam snang sgyu 'phrul sogs// thabs rgyud bde chen gsum gyi bkra shis spyon// shes rab rgyud chen dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sdom pa bde chen mchog

/rdo rje gdan bzhi sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs// ma rgyud bde chen gsum gyi bkra shis spyon// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri dang drug stong pa'i// le'ur gyur pa don dam mtshan brjod dang*// zla gsang thig le dus kyi 'khor lo sogs// gnyis med rgyud chen gsum gyi bkra shis spyon// gang 'dir drang srong rgyas pa'i gzhung lugs dang*// rnam par 'dres pa nang pa'i bstan bcos te// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung min no zhes// sngon byon chen por grags pa 'ga' zhig smra// 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las dus 'khor lo'i// chos dang yul gyi nges pa gsungs pa dang*// 'jigs med la sogs paṇa chen mang pos kyang*// rigs par bkral phyir 'gran zla kun bral ba'i// dam pa'i chos 'dis 'jig rten gzhung lugs dang*// rigs pa'i gnas la rmongs pa kun gsal nas// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i bkra shis spyon// rtsa ba'i rgyud chen de nyid bsdus pa dang*// bshad rgyud dri med rdo rje rtse mo dang*// 'jig rten gsum rgyal dpal mchog dang po sogs// rtsa bshad cha mthun rgyud kyi bkra shis spyon// don dam mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud ces dang*// dpal mchog dang po rnal 'byor bla med dang*// spyod rgyud gnyis pa bstan bcos yin no zhes// sngon byon chen po 'ga' yis gsal bar bsgrags// pad ma dkar dang kun dga'i snying po yis// mtshan brjod dpal mchog gang du bkral de dang*// sbyong rgyud gnyis pa bstan bcos yin kyang sla// drang srong gsum bzhin spyi bos blang bar rigs// rtsa ba'i rgyud chen rnam snang mngon byang chub// phyi ma'i rgyud dang bcas pa gang yin dang*// phyag na rdo rje mngon par dbang bskur ba'i// bkra shis dge legs gang yod deng 'dir spyon// rdo rje sa 'og mi 'dra rnam gnyis dang*// sa gsum rgyu ba'i rtog pa zhes bya dang*// gshin rje khog snang phyi ma'i rgyud bcas pa// blo chen la las rtsod pa can du bshad// phyag rdor rgyud gsum lung gis grub pa dang*// khog snang rgyud gsum 'grel tig khung ma 'gar// lung du drangs phyir rnam par dag go zhes// blo chen ldan pa 'ga' zhig de skad smra// bya rgyud 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang*// 'jig rten rigs kyi gzungs sngags rnam gsum dang*// legs grub spyi rgyud dpung bzang gis zhus dang*// rab gnas rgyud kyi bkra shis gang yod spyon// spyan ras gzigs rgyud pad ma'i drwa ba dang*// gnam lcags chu sogs rdo rje'i rigs kyi ni// rgyud kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig rtsod pa can// yin yang phral dang yun gyi byin rlabs la// bslu ba med phyir bkur sti'i gnas su rigs// theg mchog kun gyi rtse mo rdo rje'i theg

/ngo mtshar bsngags pa'i 'phreng ba bgrang yas kyi// pad dkar phreng mdzes 'dzin pa'i rgyud 'bum ni// gzhan gyis mi bskrun glegs bam tshogs 'di grub// ston dus dwangs pa'i kun gsal bu mo yis// nyi 'od 'bar ba'i skye mched 'thungs pa bzhin// in+d+ra ni la'i skyed tshal star ba la// gser 'od 'khyug pa'i gsungs dbyangs gar mkhan mas// pha rol yid kyi shing rta 'dren nus pa'i// bslab sbyangs lang tsho'i sbyor ba ci yang byas// gtong phod lugs brgya shes pa'i 'du 'god kyis// brtan bzhugs dga' ston rgya che gang 'dis myong*// de bskrun ma dros dpal mo'i dag byed kyis// sa skyong thugs kyi ral pa dmar po'i dug /ma lus sbyangs shing bkrus nas rang bzhin gyi// 'od gsal chos sku'i rgya mtsho der drongs shig/ ༈ //glo bo dpon po drung a seng pas mdo sde gser ma bzhengs pa'i dkar chag tu gnang ba// ༄// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bde chen zhi ba'i dbyings las mi g.yo bar// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol rtsed bsam yas kyis// rtag tu dam chos gsung ba khyod kyi zhal// 'dzum dkar 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// mā la ya rlung bsil ba'i shing rta yis// dal bur drangs pa'i ha ri tsan+dan gyi// ngad 'jam ji bzhin snying la nyer sim pa'i// gsung mchog dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// de las brgyud pa'i chos kyi gru char gyis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par gnas bcas nas// phrin las chu chen bzhi po rtag 'bebs pa// 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho che la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i phrin las ji snyed de dag las// gsung gi mdzad pa de dag mchog yin zhes// rgyal ba nyid kyis lhag par bsngags pa yi// yid 'ong bstod pa'i phreng mdzes ci yang mdzad// 'dzam gling chu bo ji snyed 'bab mkhas pa// de kun ma dros mtsho las byung de bzhin// yul khams spyi dang khyad par yul ljongs 'di'i// phan bde ji snyed dam pa'i chos las byung*// rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal// rnam grangs mang zhig rigs rgyud gong ma yis// gan shog glegs bu'i ngos la btso ma'i gser// phreng mdzes 'bur du dod pa bkod zin mod// a mes gong ma'i thug dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// yum mchog bde ba'i gnas su 'dren pa dang*// rang nyid chos kyi rgyal po'i seng ge'i khri// rab brtan mthon po'i go 'phang bzung bya'i phyir// sher phyogs zab mo'i glegs bam ji snyed pa// gser 'od 'bar ba rgyas par bsgrub zin nas// rgya chen mdo sde'i phyogs kyi chos kyi sgo// ngo mtshar brgya phrag brgyad ldan 'dir dbye bya// yid 'ong bskal pa bzang po'i mdo sde dang*// ngo mtshar rgya che rol pa'i mdo sde yis// theg chen mdo sde'i sgo mo rab phye nas// theg chen chos la spro ba thog mar bskyed// bskal bzang sprul sku'i mdzad pa bsam yas dang*// khyad par ston pa'i rnam thar bcu gcig po// gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i gzi 'od can// gang de'i bkra shis ma lus deng 'dir spyon// pad dkar rnam gsum dgongs pa nges 'grel dang*// lang kar gshegs pa gser 'od dam pa sogs// theg chen mdo sde'i gzhung shing drang po yi// zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston par du spel// byams dang snying rje theg chen thugs bskyed dang*// sna tshogs spros dang bral ba'i shes rab dang*// rgyal sras rnam thar rlabs chen spyod pa yi// bkra shis dge legs gang yod deng 'dir spyon// sangs rgyas sa dang bkra shis brgyad pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs bdun sngon gyi smon lam sogs// don mang tshig nyung ldan pa'i mdo sde yis// theg chen mdo sde'i mjug bsdud tha mar bstan// rmad du byung ba'i smon lam bgrang yas dang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bkra shis dang*// bsod nams chud mi za ba'i bsngo ba yis// dge legs bkra shis gang yod deng 'dir spyon// dran pa nyer gzhag tshangs pa'i drwa ba'i mdo// gzugs can snying po rgyal mtshan mchog la sogs// thun mong theg pa'i sgo mang rab phye nas// rgyu 'bras chos la nges pa ster bar mdzad// sdig pa'i las rnams rtsad nas drung phyung zhing*// dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin rgyu mthun dang*// bdag 'bras la sogs 'jig rten dngos grub ni// gang dang gang gi bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// rgyal mtshan dam pa dga' bo rab byung dang*// gnas mchog mdo dang tshul khrims ldan pa sogs// thun mong theg pa'i gzhung du rab bstan nas// nges 'byung thar pa'i ya mtshan dga' ston 'gyed// 'khor ba'i skyon dang zhi ba'i yon tan la// blang dor tshul bzhin 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// bdag med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog mkhas pa'i// bkra shis gang yod de ring 'dir spyon shig

/zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo sde dang*// sna tshogs dge mtshan bstan pa'i mdo rnams dang*// shis brjod smon lam bkra shis tshogs rnams kyis// thun mong theg pa'i lam bzang bsdus nas bstan// rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji bzhin gnas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin rnams kyis smon lam ci btab pa// rgyu skar rnams kyis dge mtshan gang bstan pa'i// dge legs bkra shis gang yod deng 'dir spyon// gang 'dis bskrun pa'i dge bas gnas skabs su// yab mes gong ma'i thugs la ci mchis pa'i// sdig sgrib sbyangs te mngon mtho'i lam nas ni// bde chen thar pa'i gnas der 'dzeg gyur cig /dpal skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe ring ba dang*// phun tshogs bkra shis nyin mo'i mgon gang ni// mched dang sras yum blon por bcas pa kun// ma lus srid zhi'i dpal la rol bar shog /de bskrun byed pa'i rgyu tshogs sbyor mkhas pa// kho bo a mchog seng ge'i mtshan dkar bas// thog med dus kyi las sgrib kun sbyangs te// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang de thob shog/ //de skad 'di ni sa skyong gis// ring nas bskul ba yin no zhes// blo bzang kun dga' rgyal po yi// tshig gi lam las spyon gyur pas// dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blos// rab tu dwang bas 'bad de sbyar// dge des sa skyong chen po yi// bzhed pa'i don rnams grub gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// //thub dbang bsod nams rgyas pa'i mtshan bzang po// gser 'od 'bar ba mthong ba'i mod nyid la// tshangs dang dbang po'i yid rab drangs gyur nas// zhabs zung gtsug rgyan nor bu'i khri la blangs// de gsungs kun gyi snying po rgyal ba'i yum// rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis kyang rnyed dka' ba// de gsungs dus kyi thog mar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal bas bstod bskur bsngags pa'i phreng mdzes phul// rgyal ba nyid kyis thub pa'i gsung rab kun// ma lus kun las gang 'di'i tshig don gcig

/khyad par 'phags shes chos kyi mdzod 'dzin la// bstod bskur bsngags pas lan gsum rjes gtad pa// sras yum bcu bdun 'khor dang bcas pa ni// mthing shog glegs bu'i ngos la btso ma gser// 'od 'bar 'bur du dod pa'i glegs bam tshogs// gsung gi dbang phyug rgyal po'i ngo bor byon// gang khyod mar gyur 'gro ba'i mgron po rnams// mi gnas myang ngan 'das pa'i lam chen po// ji srid ma drangs de srid sa chen 'dir// brtan par bzhugs pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// gang spyod seng ge'i khri la bzhugs gsol te// mchod cing bkur bsti byed pa'i rim gro pas// 'dzin 'chang klog dang kha bton bgyis pa yis// gzhan gyis mi bskrun bde legs gang 'dir spyon// khyod don lan gcig bsams pa'i mod nyid las// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i me tog mda'// kun gyi yid la 'jug pa'ang phyir ldog na// gzhan gyis mi thub bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// rgyal yum rgyas pa bam po sum brgya pa// bsod nams tshogs dang rnam par dag pa dang*// stong pa nyid dang de bzhin nyid dang ni// dum bu rnam bzhi khams pa go chas bsgyur// gang 'di thugs 'gyur yin pas ma dag pa'i// dogs pa 'tshal nas btsan po'i bka' lung gis// bod 'bangs yongs la dpya dang khral bsdus nas// myang ban in+t+ra a rong zhes bya dang*// dbas ban mañdzu shrī yi rgya dpe las// dngos su bsgyur bas dum bu drug pa byung*// de nyid lhag chad med pas dag par dgongs// de las 'phel ba gangs can ljongs na mang*// phyi dus lha gcig ral pa can gyi bkas// ka lcog zhang gi brgya dpe du ma la// legs par gtugs pa'i bla 'gyur rgyas pa ni// bcu gnyis dum dang bcu bzhi pa sogs byung*// khyad par bsdus 'bring gnyis kyi mjug brtags nas// bco brgyad dum par byas pa'ang mang zhig yod// de ltar phyi mo gsum gyi dbye ba las// rgyal yum rgyas pa'i dbye ba rnam gsum byung*// rnam dpyod gsal ldan bshes gnyen shar ba pas// rgyan dang le'u brgyad ma'i rjes 'brangs nas// gtan la phab cing zhus chen mang du mdzad// gang 'di kun gyi yid ches gnas su bya// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung rnams las// 'ga' zhig sngags kyi tshul du bkral gyur nas// dngos grub rnam gnyis bsgrub pa'i tshul bzhugs kyang*// rang gi ngo bo pha rol phyin pa'i tshul// de bskrun tshogs gnyis nyi zla'i 'od 'bar ba// nam yang mun pa'i lam du mi 'jug par// rtag tu gong nas gong du 'gro 'grus pas// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang de snyogs shog

/'dir 'ongs bsod nams 'jigs med dpa' bo yis// pha rol khros pa'i me tog gzhu bcag nas// rang sde bsrung ba'i gzhu rgyal dpung tshogs bzhis// rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdung ba de byos shig /rgyas pa'i yum gyis mtshan 'dzin rtog pa bsal// bar ma'i yum gyis mngon rtogs lam bzang ston// bsdus pa'i yum gyis srid zhi'i rgud pa kun// sel byed yum gsum bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// //chos dbyings nags kyi skye mched la song bas// bde chen zhi ba'i stan las mi bzhengs kyang*// rtag tu sgyu ma'i rol rtsed la chags pas// dam chos gsung ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba de yi sku gsung thugs kyis ni// bgrang yas phrin las ji snyed de dag las// gsung gi mdzad pa rnam pa thams cad pa// mchog tu bsngags pa'i phreng ba ci yang mdzad// yid 'ong bskal ba bzang po'i mdo sde dang*// ngo mtshar rgya cher rol pa'i mdo sde yis// rgya chen chos kyi sgo brgya rab phye nas// theg chen chos la spro ba dang por bskyed// bskal bzang sprul sku'i mdzad pa bsam yas dang*// khyad par ston pa'i rnam thar bcu gcig po// gong nas gong du spel ba'i gzi 'od can// gang de'i bkra shis ma lus deng 'dir spyon// pad dkar rnam gsum dgongs pa nges 'grel dang*// lang kar gshegs pa gser 'od dam pa sogs// theg chen mdo sde'i gzhung shing drang po yis// zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston par du spel// byams dang snying rje byang chub thugs mchog dang*// sna tshogs spros dang bral ba'i shes rab dang*// rgyal sras rnam thar rlabs chen spyod pa yi// bkra shis bde legs gang mchis deng 'dir spyon// sangs rgyas sa dang bkra shis brgyad pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs bdun sngon gyi smon lam sogs// don mang tshig nyung ldan pa'i mdo sde yi// theg chen mdo sde'i mjug bsdud tha mar bstan// rmad du byung ba'i smon lam bgrang yas dang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bkra shis dang*// bsod nams chud mi za ba'i bsngo ba yi// bde legs bkra shis gang mchis deng 'dir spyon// dran pa nyer gzhag tshangs pa'i drwa ba'i mdo// gzugs can snying po rgyal mtshan mchog la sogs// thun mong theg pa'i sgo mangs rab phye nas// rgyu 'bras chos la nges pa ster bar mdzad// sdig pa'i las rnams rtsad nas drungs 'byin zhing*// dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin rgyu mthun dang*// bdag 'bras la sogs 'jig rten dngos grub ni// gang dang gang gi bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// rgyan mtshan dam pa dga' bo rab byung dang*// gnas mchog mdo dang tshul khrims ldan pa sogs// thun mong theg pa'i gzhung du rab bstan nas// nges 'byung thar pa'i ya mtshan dga' ston dang*// 'khor ba'i skyon dang zhi ba'i yon tan la// blang dor tshul bzhin 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// bdag med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrog mkhas pa'i// bde legs bkra shis gang mchis deng 'dir spyon// zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo sde dang*// sna tshogs dge mtshan bstan pa'i mdo rnams dang*// shis brjod smon lam bkra shis tshogs rnams kyis// thun mong theg pa'i lam bzang bsdus te bstan// rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji bzhin gnas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin rnams kyis smon lam gang btab pa// rgyu skar rnams kyis dge mtshan gang bstan pa'i// bde legs bkra shis gang yod deng 'dir spyon// de bskrun bkra shis nyin mo'i mgon gang gis// 'chi bdag nub kyi ri brgya 'gongs pa na// 'gran 'dod skar mas khengs pa'i 'od bskyungs te// phun tshogs shar gyi ri la 'char bar shog

/sngon gyi lha chen mes po'i gdung rus la// rnam par zhen pa'i mtshan 'dzin dri ma'i tshogs// dag byed lhag bsam skal ldan shing rta'i khrir// bsod nams lam gsum ldan pa 'di blangs so// //zhing mchog nor 'dzin dpal mo'i 'phang pa na// 'phrin las rol mtsho'i dbus su nyer bzung ba'i// thub dbang sku bzhi'i lhun po 'od 'bar ba// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la phyag bgyi'o// 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyan gyi le'u nas// sdong pos rgyan pa'i le'u zhe lnga'i bar// tshigs bcad sum khri dgu stong sum cu pa// phal chen mdo sde'i dbang po 'dir spyon to// gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i// 'jig rten khams na kun tu bzang po yi// rnam thar las byung mchod pa'i sprin tshogs kyi// bkra shis bde legs gang yod deng 'dir spyon// gang 'di'i glegs bam margad 'khyil ba'i mtsho// gser 'od 'bar ba'i rlabs kyis nyer 'khyud pa// de bskrun byed po'i bsod nams char chen yang*// dag pa'i zhing gi rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /rin chen chos kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba// gong nas gong du brtsegs pa'i le lag ni// stong phrag brgya par grags pa las phyung ba'i// 'dus pa zhe dgur grags la phyag bgyi'o// sdom gsum bstan dang sgo mtha' yas pa yi// rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gsang ba'i sgo phye nas// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' yas pa// nges don chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// 'od dpag med dang mi 'khrugs 'jam dpal gyi// zhing bkod bstan pas dang ba 'dren byas nas// kun nas sgo sogs byang chub sems dpa' yi// theg pa nges bstan chos kyi bkra shis spyon// yab sras mjal dang sgyu ma mkhan bzang po// lung bstan sogs kyis rgyal la dang byas nas// 'char byed kyis zhus la sogs mdo sde yis// spyod pa nges bstan chos kyi bkra shis spyon// sangs rgyas spyod yul bsam mi khyab pa dang*// dpal phreng seng ge'i nga ro'i mdo sogs kyi// don dam mthar thug de bzhin gshegs snying po// ston mdzad chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// mya ngan 'das chen le'u bcu gsum pa// drang nges 'byed pa'i mdo sde nges gsal bas// sangs rgyas snying po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba// ston byed chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// mya ngan 'das chen le tshan mi 'dra ba// khri dang lnga stong las byung lha mi yi// zhus pa'i le'ur grags pa rtsod dang bral// mya ngan 'das chung rtsod pa can du grags// mya ngan 'das chen rgya nag las bsgyur ba// bam grangs lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhugs pa yang*// rnam dag theg pa chen po'i chos yin zhes// sngon byon rnam dpyod ldan pa 'ga' zhig gsung*// de bskrun byed pa'i bsod nams chu chen bzhi// legs byas chu phran nyis stong gi bskor ba// chos dang srid kyi ma dros mtsho chen po// rnam par brjid pa'i dpal de thob par bsngo//

//swasti/ mtshan bzang nyi 'od 'bar ba'i 'dzum dkar ni// rnam dkar lang tsho'i dbus su nyer son pas// sgrib kun sel byed bdud rtsi'i 'bab ngogs mchog /dam pa'i chos khyod sum rtsen dpag bsam shing*// sangs rgyas mtshan bzang lnga bcu las lhag pa'i// lnga stong bzhi brgya 'bar ba dus kyi me// sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg la thogs med cing*// gser 'od nor rgyun 'dod dgu'i bum pa bzang*// gang 'di'i glegs bam mthing shog nam mkha' la// gser dngul nyi zla'i bgros kyi rnam bkra ba// yi ger bris so mkhas kun dga' byed cing*// yon gyi bdag po'i bde legs spel de yin// de las byung ba'i dge legs nor bu'i 'od// rim dang bsod nams mang po'i khor yug tu// phrin las chu chen brgya yis rtag 'dud pa// dpal ldan skye dgu'i mgon de thugs kyi mtshor// ye shes zla bzhin 'char ba'i gegs gyur pa// sgrib gnyis rtog pa'i tshogs rnams dwangs bya'i phyir// lhag bsam sgrin 'grus bzang pos skrun byed mkhan// 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin rje btsun slob dpon ma'i// sras 'khrungs stong dpon 'a zhwa'i mched lcam mo// byang sems sangs rgyas 'bum de'i rnam dkar dge /de bskrun de las mnga' 'bangs bde ba dang*// pha rol dgra bo'i 'tshe ba med pa dang*// rang srid dbu rmog gong nas gong btsan zhing*// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phangs de thob shog/ //mthon mthing gan shog gsar pa'i na gzhon 'od dmar 'khyug pa'i bzhin mdangs rab gsal ha ri tsan+dan gser 'od 'bar ba'i glegs bu dang bcas chos dang srid kyi lang tsho dar ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang byed// btso ma'i gser gyi thig phreng 'bur du dod pa'i 'phrul yig sgeg mo'i lus 'gyur gyis ni rnam dpyod mdza' bo'i yid kyi shing rta nges par 'dren pa'i 'dzum phreng star la rgyus pa'i zlos gar ci yang byas// gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i skye mched mtshar pos kai la sha ri'i ljongs 'dir bka' lung gang 'gyur glegs bam mtshar po'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bab stegs las ni 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gtam gyi rol mo ci yang byon// gang 'dir bde bar 'ongs pa'i ngo mtshar chos kyi mya ngan med ma nam yang phan bde'i mdza' bo dang ni nges par 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur len 'dis ni gnas skabs bde zhing yun du phan gyur cig/

//e ma ngo mtshar dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpyang thag la 'jus srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'jigs pa'i snyegs pa dang bcas rnam grol ro brgya'i sbrang rtsi zhim po yis ni yid rab drangs pa'i gang gang gdul bya de de la ni bden bzhi'i thabs kyi theg pa yid 'ong gang 'dir khyod kyi dang por bstan// yang yang bskyang pa'i ma rnams kyis ni sdig dang sdug bsngal rtsub mos yid kyi glang chen nges drangs srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug la bsam gtan bde ba'i dga' ba btang nas stong nyid zhi ba'i nags kyi sman ljongs nyams dgar yid kyi glang chen nges par dul nas srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug la smon par dga' ba de de la ni bden gnyis tshul gyi theg pa de yang khyod kyis bstan// chos rnams kun gyi gnas rnams mkhyen pa'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan de'i rnam 'phrul gyis ni gang zhig gang gang la dga'i khams dang dbang po'i rim pa ji bzhin de dang de la 'tshas zhing rigs pa'i chos kyi sgo chen brgyad khri bzhi stong bkod mdzes mtshar du bsgrigs pa'i go skabs yangs par rab phye nas// ngo mtshar lha yi sgyu ma'i rnam rol mkhan de'i rol rtsed kyis ni mang po'i yid rab 'dren pa ji bzhin phan dang bde ba'i lam srol 'byed pos sna tshogs chos kyi rnga dbyangs snyan po'i zlos gar gyis ni sa 'dir brel 'phongs med pa'i chos kyi longs spyod ster mkhas kun mkhyen de la phyag 'tshal lo// //lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las kyis// zhes sogs so// //nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yis ni rgyu gzhan rgyu ba nges par dag pa'i mi 'gyur bde chen drug brgyas lhag pa'i chig stong nyi khri gsung dbyangs rnam pa thams cad pa// chos dbyings zhi ba'i lang tsho ma des drangs pa'i bde chen 'khor lo'i rnam rol nyid la rtag par zhen pas rin chen khri las mi ldang thugs kyi rnam pa thams cad pa// chos sku'i gzhal med khang mtho pho brang mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus las g.yo med bde chen sgyu ma'i gar gyi rnam rol du mas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sku yi bkod pa thams cad pa// stong nyid snying rje'i nyams kyis longs spyod kun rdzogs zung 'jug bde chen rgyun chad med pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang sku gsung thugs kyi rnam rol mi zad pa der phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po sogs so//

//maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu// //zhi ba'i tshul khrims rang bzhin nyes pas dben// rnam dag tshul khrims bcas pa'i khor yug la// nam yang mi 'da' chos 'dul yid bzhin mtsho// ston mdzad thub chen de la phyag bgyi'o// 'dul ba'i bka' lung bod du 'gyur ba la// sh+lau ka 'bum sder grags pa yin gyur kyang*// rtsa ba'i lung gnyis bshad lung sde bzhi po// phyogs mthun dang bcas 'bum sder nye ba tsam// pha ma'i so thar sh+lau ka bdun brgya dang*// brgyad brgyar bgrang ba bam po gnyis gnyis pa// 'di nang bzhugs pa'i so thar mdo bstod pa// chos kyi tshong dpon gyis byas bstan bcos zer// bshad lung sde bzhi'i thog ma lung bzhi dang*// rnam 'byed yin zhes sngon gyi dkar chag dang*// rin chen grub kyi bshad pa so so ba// bzhi la bam po brgya dang dgur grags pa// sh+lau ka gsum khri nyis stong bdun brgya pa// rnam 'byed bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa// sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgyar bzhed// dge slong ma rnams bam po nyer brgyad pa// thams cad yod smra'i 'dul ba ma yin mod// sde pa gzhan gyi lung las 'chugs zhes pa// bu ston chen po'i rnam dpyod rtsal gyis bton// phran tshegs sgo brgyad rdzogs pa'i bam po'i grangs// lnga bcu rtsa dgur tshul khrims bskyangs kyis bshad// bshad lung phyi ma bam po nga gsum pa// zhu ba mang shos sbyar ba'i rgyas pa dang*// zhu ba ma rdzogs bam po bcu gnyis pa// gnyis la gzhung dam zhes byar 'chad mod kyi// 'gyur dang bsgyur sa'i khyad par ma gtogs pa// rgyas pa'i gzhung las logs su bgrang mi dgos// de phyir gzhung dam le tshan bcu gcig la// bam po nga gsum pa nyid tshad mar bya// rnam 'byed rnam gnyis so thar rnam gnyis kyi// tshig gi 'grel yin dge slong pha ma yi// tshul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang*// sum brgya drug cu'i bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// 'dul ba lung gzhi rnam 'byed rnam gnyis kyi// kha skong 'grel yin ma thob thob pa dang*// thob zin mi nyams nyams na phyir bcos pa'i// thabs tshul dri med ston pa'i bkra shis spyon// gzhi dang rnam 'byed gnyis kyi don zhib mo// gsal bar 'chad pa phran tshegs sgo brgyad de// bdun cu bzhi dang rtogs dka'i rnam 'byed don// tshul bzhin bshad pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// lung gsum gyis bstan don tshan re re yang*// zhus lan tshul gyis rgyas par rab phye nas// mtha' gzhan srid pa'i dogs pa dang bral bar// 'chad byed bla ma'i lung gi bkra shis spyon// gnam sngon brdar ba'i gdong mdzes bstar ba la// gser 'od 'bar ba'i thig phreng kha lo pas// gang drangs mdo lung sde bzhi'i nyin mor byed// bkra shis srid sde'i mgon gyis 'di blangs so// thub chen gser 'od 'bar ba'i khyams mthil du// snam sbyar rlabs kyi phreng bas nyer mdzes pa'i// phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'dus pa'i mtsho chen po// gzhi gsum khor yug yangs par gnas byos shig

/gang der bstan pa'i gru bo che// gang bzung lung dang rigs pa yi// skya ba 'dzin pa'i bsod nams kyang*// phrin las lhun gyis grub par shog /bkra shis nyin mor byed mgon gyi// bsod nams rta brgya 'deg pa la// a mes gong ma'i rigs mchog gi /gdung 'dzin seng ge'i mtshan dkar ba// lhun po ji bzhin brtan pa dang*// rang sde skyong la yid mdzangs shing*// gzhan sde gnon la blo dpa' ba// dge zhing rtag tu legs pa yang*// rgya mtsho ji bzhin gang bar shog /se chen gan gyi sa skyong ba'i// bla ma'i rigs 'khrungs slob dpon ma// dkon mchog rgyal mo sras bcas ni// ring du 'tsho zhing dge gyur cig /a mi de wa'i byin rlabs kyis// ma sangs srid dang zhi ba yi// dpal dang 'byor pas gang phyug pa// chos kyi rgyal po'i sar bzhugs nas// ar+ya pa lo'i thugs rje yis// sa chen skyong ba'i mgon gyur pa// phrin las bzang po'i gang de yang*// sa bcu'i rtse mo der son shog /rigs kyi yum gyur dpal dang ni// sras 'bangs skyong la blo mdzangs shing*// rgyal ba'i sras kyi thugs mnga' mo// 'tsho zhing rgyal ba nyid gyur cig /sa skyong sras dang blon por bcas// mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba dang*// pha rol 'tshe ba med pa dang*// srid zhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal shog/ //so thar gnyis dang dran pa nyer gzhag tshangs pa'i drwa ba la sogs bden bzhi'i 'khor lo'i sna tshogs pad ma nyi ma'i steng na sher phyogs glegs bam sum cu'i stong nyid rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba bla bre khor yug skor ba'i phyogs dang phyogs bral rnams su gzungs sngags 'bum gyi glegs bam zab mo'i mda'i drwa ba dang ni ye shes me lce 'bar ba'i klog gi phreng ba can// phal chen glegs bam rnam drug yid 'ong 'dod yon snam bu dmar po'i 'gram thabs ring pos rigs par bskor ba'i rwa ba la brten dkon mchog rin chen glegs bam rnam brgyad brtsegs pa'i rtsig pa rim lnga mtho ba'i steng du rtogs brjod skye rabs gser gyi pha gu ser po'i ba gam mdzes byas mya ngan 'das mdo'i chu srin kha nas phyung ba'i bkra shis gsar pa'i mu tig do shal nges par 'phyang*// sna tshogs mdo sde'i glegs bam gnyis bcas sum cu'i mda' yab dkar po gyen du langs shing rin chen shar bu 'thur du 'phyang ba'i bar mtshams la lar 'od 'bar nor bu'i do shal dang ni do shal phyed pa'i rtse nas skyugs pa'i gser gyi g.yer kha'i gsung snyan gyis ni yid rab dang rnams kho nar ma zad phrag dog rtsub mo'i thang du 'phyan pa'i phyogs kyi mgron po'i yid kyang 'gugs par byed// bshad lung sde bzhi'i sgo bzhi glegs bam bang rim bzhi bzhi'i steng na gdugs phan rnga yab nor bu'i phreng ldan tshangs dang dbang po'i rna bar len pa'i rnga sgra dang bcas bya spyod lha rnams rnal 'byor rgyud kyi ka chen gyi mdzes pha rgyud rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyis bskor ma rgyud zab mo'i bum pa dang ni chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis med rgyud kyi nor bu 'bar ba'i tog mdzes rnam par g.yo// ma la ya rlung sogs so// bshad lung sde bzhi'i 'byung ba rim gyis brtsegs// rgyud 'bum rdo rje'i rwa bas khor yug bskor// mdo mangs phyi'i mtsho chen nges par gang*// phal chen dkon brtsegs 'dzam gling bcu gnyis pa// smon lam shis brjod nang gi rol mtshos gang*// nges don ri bo drug gi nang rol na// kun gyi snying por sher phyin lhun po yis// rnam par brjid pa'i zhing khams 'di 'khrungs so// gang 'di bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod na// rnam 'gyur 'jug pa rnam bcu'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan// rnam dpyod khyab 'jug lag pa ring po yis// nges par bskrun pa gang 'di ngo mtshar to// gang 'di sa skyong chen po yis// gsung gi rnga chen gyis bskul nas// yul dbus ljongs kyi snyan dngags mkhan// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis so//

//'char kha'i mdangs gsal bye bas 'khyud pa'i sku// mes po'i snying la nyer sim byed pa'i gsung*// tshe dang bsod nams char bzhin 'bebs pa'i thugs// thub chen rgyal ba de yis mgon mdzod cig /de ltar bsod nams yongs 'du'i dpag bsam las// rim par 'ongs pa'i legs tshogs sbrang rtsi'i bcud// mthar byed mche ba'i lam du mi 'gro bar// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal du 'di gyur cig /dge legs shar gyi ri bo'i phrag pa la// rab 'khod 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i lang tsho yis// mtha' yas 'jig rten gsum gyi yid 'dzin pa// thub chen ston pa de la phyag bgyi'o// gtong phod lugs brgya ldan pa'i chu bo bzhis// bsod nams yid bzhin mtsho chen rab gang nas// sa gsum skye bo'i rgud pa sel brtson pas// phan bde'i sgo brgya phye ba nyid yin no// //maṅga laṃ// //bha wan+tu// //oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gang 'dir sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ gtan tshigs rig pa'i gzhung lugs las brtsams pa'i nyan bshad kyi grwa chen po 'di ni/ thog mar mkhas grub a mo gha shrī bha dra/ sa skyong chen po nor bu bzang pos/ chu pho spre'u'i lo la bsam grub rtser spyan drangs nas legs par btsugs/ de nas lo nyer lnga pa me pho spre'u'i lo la/ chos rgyal don grub rdo rje dpon blon gyis/ chos sde'i gzhi rkyen gyi thog ma btsugs/ lung nang gi dpon g.yog pas kun dga' rwa ba bsgrubs nas/ dgon pa'i mtshan thub bstan gser mdog can zhes btags/ de nas lo bcu gsum pa sa pho spre'u'i lo la dga' ldan gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/ ma pham mthong ba don yod seng ge'i khri la spyan drongs/ dus de nas dkon mchog gsum gyi rten zab cing rgya che ba dang*/ yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin tshogs/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnam bzhis bsrungs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po grub pa'i skabs 'dir/ ston pa rgyal ba nyid kyi gsung dang rtsod bral gyi bstan bcos dag la tshul bzhin du 'chad pa dang nyan pa ni/

dgos pa'i yang dgos par gyur pas na de'i lugs kyi bca' ba mdor bsdus pa ni 'di ltar/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mtshan nyid pa zhes grags pa'i bshad pa'i srol ni/ sa rngog gnyis su grags pa las/ gzhan la brgyud pa'i khungs med/ de dag las lung byams pa'i chos dang*/ dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum/ bslab spyod la sogs pa'i bskor rnams dang*/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa/ bsdus pa'i srol snga ma dag dang bcas pa rngog lo chen po nas brgyud/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel bsdus pa'i bshad srol/ rigs pa'i gter dang bcas pa sa lo nas brgyud/ de ltar phar tshad kyi nyan bshad cal col gzhan dang ma 'dres pa de chos grwa 'dir gzhung shing du byed dgos/ de yang thog mar gzhung ṭīka mi slob pa'i bshad nyan gyi bstan pa chud gson/ rnam bshad rje gong ma gnyis kyi gsung sgros par du grub pa de dag 'chad pa pos lag tu blangs nas 'dzin du 'jug de la dgos pa'i ngag don rnam bshad so so dang mthun pa'i sbyor phreng re re yod/ de las gzhan gyis grwa 'dir phan mi thogs tshad ma'i spyi don du sbyar ba ji snyed pa'i rang lugs rigs pa'i gter las gzhan du med/ phar phyin gyi spyi don chen mo dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi rang lugs rnam bshad chen mo las gzhan du mi 'da'/ phar phyin gyi rnam bshad rab sgang ma dang lung chos snying po byams chos sgom lugs pa'i bshad srol dang bstun/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bshad srol pa lo nas zhang thang la brgyud pa/ rje rong chen pa dpon slob la byung ba de las gzhan du brgyud pa mi 'da'/ spyir phar tshad dbu gsum yi bshad pa dus phyis grags pa de sun 'byin lugs 'bad rtsol gyis ston pa 'di las gzhan du mi 'da' bar bzung na/ sngon bod yul du byon pa'i gzhung lugs pa kun gyi grub mtha' rang byon du lhun gyis grub pas na gzhan du 'chos mi dgos/ las dang po la nyer mkho'i thal phreng tshig dang don la 'jug pa'i rnam gsal rtsom shes pa byung na sus byas kyang bkag pa med/

gzhung tshad ma lan cig tsam yang 'dzin ma myong ba'i grwa skor gyis bstan pa la mi phan zhing*/ rang rgyud kyang mi chos bla ma cha mthun gyis/ chud 'dza' 'dul mngon gyi bstan pa deng sang gang yod de chud zos pa mi snang yang*/ rang res go bde ba dang zur phyin par bkod pa de dag gro skyor gyi brgyud pa las 'ongs pa dang mthun/ de ltar yin pa de'i phyir/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i bshad srol la bslab sbyangs byed pa dag kyang*/ rang rang gang la slob pa'i chos de'i brgyud pa gang las byung ba'i bshes gnyen de dag la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang*/ don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa phun sum tshogs pas bsgrub par bya'o// gnas 'dir phyi nas 'byon 'gyur ba'i// don gnyer rnams la de skad du// bca' ba rnam par bzhag pa yis// thub bstan rgya mtsho gang bar shog/ //shu bhaṃ// //oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rang re'i ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng rnyog pa med pa la sgo gsum rab tu dwang bas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// gang des legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byang nas so so thar pa'i tshul khrims mod mi dma' ba dag la gnas shing*/ tshul ji lta ba bzhin du bsrung ba ni/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gong ma dag kyang skye ba dang gnas pa dang mgo 'dren par byed pa'i med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu dang*/ yon yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ chud mi 'dza' bar byed pa'i thabs dam pa dag ste/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas 'dul ba gangs can mtsho// gting mtha' med pa thams cad kyi// gnas pa'i snying dang snying po ni// so sor thar pa 'di yin no// 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yi// chos kun gyi ni 'dren pa mchog /ces so// de'i phyir gnas bkra shis kyi kun dga' rwa ba 'dir 'du ba'i dge slong dang*/ dge tshul dag gi tshul khrims su bca' ba mdor bsdus pa ni/ tha na dge slong lngar longs pa yan chad dang*/

dge tshul lnga la sogs pas kyang*/ dbyar zla ba gsum du nges par gnas pa nyid du khas len/ de ltar gnas pa'i phan yon dang bslab bya gzhung du gsal/ gnas pa de la gnas dang*/ zas kyi rnyed pa zhag grangs dang mthun pa/ gos rnyed dang rdzas kyi dgag dbye dag chos gzhis pas dgag dbye'i mthar ci 'byor 'bul/ dus der dge slong gi bslab bya dang*/ dge tshul dag gi'ang bslab bya ma lus pa mdo na gsal bas/ de'i nyan bshad ci nus dang*/ nyan thos kyi 'dul ba rnam par nges pa la bslab sbyangs dpyis phyin par mdzad/ gso sbyong gis ni bcas rkyang gi nyes pa mtha' dag dang*/ rang bzhin gyi'ang byin gyis brlobs pas nges par nan tan du bya/ de dus kyi btung ba'i khyad par yang ci 'byor du chos gzhis pas sgrub/ de'i tshe mdo 'don pa po ni/ spyir btang du gnas brtan gyi bgyi ba yin kyang*/ dmigs bsal du/ blo la thon pa'i bslab pa gzhon pas kyang seng ge'i khri chung la 'dug nas 'don par gsungs pa la sus kyang 'thing slad mi bya/ dus 'dir ni gtso bor dge 'dun dbyen gyi 'jigs pa dang bral bar bya dgos pas/ chos dang zang zing gi bgo skal la mnyam por longs spyod/ 'dus shing za ba'i ltung byed kyi dgag bya gang yin dran par bya/ dge slong dag gis ni tha na'ang byin rlabs 'chags su rung ba tsam gyi chos gos rnam pa gsum tshang ba dang*/ dbyar nang du lhung bzed dang gding ba med par gzhan gyi zas dang stan la longs mi spyod/ dus go dang bslab bral tshul bzhin du sgrig mthong thos dogs gsum gang rang gi gzhi yod pa'i khrims 'chal tshogs bral du mi 'jug gzhi gsum po la nan tan du bgyi ba'i tshogs pas de las gzhan rab tu byung ba bag yangs su byed pa dag khrims su bya ba che chung gis 'chos dgos de la rgol na dge 'dun spyi dang 'gal/ de ltar sgrub pa thams cad kyi do dam ched gnyer tshags 'jug gtsug lag khang 'dir rgyun zhugs kyi dge slong*/

byams pa'i chos dang 'dul ba'i bslab sbyangs la gnas pa gzhir longs shig dang*/ mchod bshoms dang gnyer 'dzin pa'i dge tshul gnyis dang bcas pa bzhugs pa des/ dka' tshegs la mi lta bar byed dgos/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs lam gsum pas// 'dus pa'i yid bzhin rgya mtsho 'phel ba dang*// lung rtogs rin chen tshogs kyis gang ba dang*// phrin las chu chen dus su phebs par shog/ //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
